name: Profanity
overview: Scripture teaches that the words we speak carry profound spiritual weight, as seen in Proverbs 18:21 where life and death are in the power of the tongue. The Lord commands us not to take His name in vain, warning of accountability for misuse (Exodus 20:7). Jesus emphasizes that the words we speak reveal our true purity and that every idle word will be judged (Matthew 15:11, 12:36). Therefore, believers are called to exercise holy speech, offering their bodies and words as a living sacrifice pleasing to God (Romans 12:1), guarding their tongues from evil and deceit (Psalms 34:13).
